title: Turn a cloud bill into an accountable unit cost
description: Choose a workload, allocation policy, and demand level. The model separates visible cost from fully loaded cost so missing ownership cannot look like efficiency.
modelNote: The costs, coverage rates, targets, and demand curves are teaching fixtures. Use reconciled billing data, documented allocation rules, and authoritative business outcomes in production.

workloads.label: Checkout platform
workloads.detail: A customer-facing path with a stable completed-order outcome.

workloads.label: Analytics workspace
workloads.detail: A multi-tenant product where queries are useful but vary greatly in resource intensity.

workloads.label: Model serving
workloads.detail: An inference service where accepted responses provide a better denominator than raw tokens alone.

allocationPolicies.label: Invoice total only
allocationPolicies.detail: The bill is reconciled, but product ownership and shared-cost rules are absent.

allocationPolicies.label: Resource tags only
allocationPolicies.detail: Tagged resources map to products, while shared services and missing metadata remain unresolved.

allocationPolicies.label: Derived allocation ledger
allocationPolicies.detail: Accounts, tags, ownership records, and a documented demand driver allocate direct and shared cost.
